_note: Curated shipped model catalog: LITERAL model facts only (identity, provider, label, limits, local-vs-cloud, whether the row is still offered). Canonical identity/capabilities are seeded from models.dev and reviewed at release. It carries NO price, score, accuracy, policy or ranking of any kind -- selection is the user's, not a resolver's -- and no local-hardware facts: RAM/download/KV live once, in inference/hardware.go's rung table (E4.3). This file never claims a model is callable: runtime availability comes only from backend bindings and probes. Packs map these canonical identities to private upstream model IDs without exposing those IDs here.
